name: Grey Verge
storyline: The Grey Verge is a mysterious realm that emerged between the worlds of light and darkness. Vergewalkers venture into this strange realm, crossing paths with one another as they seek to uncover its origins and discover where it ultimately leads.
summary: Grey Verge is a roguelite deckbuilder built around a distinct combat system focused on grouping cards and chaining powerful combos. Players form a team of three characters, build their deck, and use Marks that alter the rules of combat to create different strategies and playstyles.
